headlines.title: Fed interest rate vote poses a test for Warsh as Iran war, tariff push send prices higher
headlines.description: Inflation and affordability are top issues for the Federal Reserve’s rate-setting committee as it votes on whether to raise interest rates or keep them steady.

headlines.title: James Comey legal team argues DOJ’s seashells case erodes ‘bedrock’ principles
headlines.description: It’s the second time the Trump administration has found a way to criminally charge the former FBI director, whom Trump has targeted for years.

headlines.title: Iran Launches Surprise Missile Attack on US Forces in Middle East
headlines.description: After a dayslong pause in direct strikes between the United States and Iran, the war is flaring up again after U.S. Central Command said it intercepted multiple ballistic missiles launched in a surprise attack by Iran on US forces late Tuesday. It comes just hours after President Donald Trump touted progress in peace talks and as the conflict enters its sixth month. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Dr. Anthony Fauci's journal reveals how Trump and Biden handled Covid cases
headlines.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci's journal entries, published this week by a Republican senator, offer new details about how the administrations of Presidents Donald Trump and Joe Biden handled their Covid cases. NBC News’ Monica Alba explains the journal revelations as Fauci is set to testify before a Senate committee.

headlines.title: Trump meets with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Zelenskyy at the White House
headlines.description: President Donald Trump held closed-door meetings with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy at the White House before the world leaders paid their respects to the late Sen. Lindsey Graham. NBC News' Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Francesca Hong avoids attacks as Wisconsin Democrats meet for governor debate
headlines.description: The five Democratic candidates for governor in Wisconsin almost entirely refrained from lobbing attacks at one another during their only debate Tuesday night, even as the volatile race enters its final two weeks.

headlines.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to overturn $83.3 million award in E. Jean Carroll defamation case
headlines.description: Lawyers for President Donald Trump argued that he had immunity for statements made while president.

headlines.title: South Dakota Gov. Larry Rhoden fends off challenger in GOP primary runoff
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Rhoden, who replaced Kristi Noem last year, defeated businessman Toby Doeden to win the Republican nomination for governor.

headlines.title: Two Democrats advance to runoff in Georgia special election to succeed late Rep. David Scott
headlines.description: Scott’s daughter Marcye Scott and fellow Democrat Everton Blair finished atop a five-candidate field, but no one got majority support, triggering the runoff, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Senate confirms Jay Clayton as new director of intelligence
headlines.description: The Senate approved federal prosecutor Jay Clayton as the next director of national intelligence.

headlines.title: How Ken Martin is holding on as DNC chair — for now: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki digs into Ken Martin’s woes at the Democratic National Committee.
